newsitem.title: SPAIN: Mid-session Madrid stocks firm, Telefonica shines.
newsitem.headline: Mid-session Madrid stocks firm, Telefonica shines.

text.p: Madrid stocks were firm at midsession helped by bond gains after a lower-than-expected October CPI number.
The Ibex-35 was up 16.88 points, 0.38 percent to 4,486.78.

Telefonica continued dynamic, up 55 pesetas to 2,795 backed by a strong buy order from a final investor for some days, dealers said. Prospects for a 21 percent rise in nine-month results were also helping the shares, along with the fact that telecoms stocks in general are very much in demand in Europe.
FCC, which announced flat nine-month results, was up 70 pesetas to 10,850,
